caption: The drawing is a patterned composition arranged in a grid of diamond shapes. The dominant colors are shades of brown, blue, green, cream, red, and white. There are three large brown diamond sections, each containing an American bald eagle with outstretched wings holding an olive branch and arrows in its talons, perched above a red, white, and blue shield with stars above. Smaller diamonds alternate in a repeating pattern around these larger diamonds, displaying either state seals or symbols, each labeled with abbreviations or names corresponding to U.S. states or concepts, rendered in light brown or sepia tones on darker backgrounds. Additional diamonds contain stylized American flags with red and white stripes and sections of light blue with white stars. The diamonds are arranged so that the overall pattern alternates between images of the eagle, state seals, and American flags, thereby creating a visually structured and repetitive grid using patriotic symbols and state insignias. The outer margin of the drawing is a plain tan border.
title: Textile (State Emblems)
